avv-baidu-1.webp.en: The tensioned-fabric canopy outside the terminal, spreading over the forecourt and walkways on its steel frame.

avv-baidu-2.webp.zh: 到达与出发门口：外墙标着「国内到达」与「国际及国内出发」，旁边还有中文指示（阿瓦隆机场长期接待中国航线）。
avv-baidu-2.webp.en: The arrivals and departures doors — 'Domestic Arrivals' beside 'International & Domestic Departures', the signage in Chinese as well for Avalon's China services.
